name: Beijing Science Sun Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Science Sun Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is a company, established in 1999 and headquartered in Beijing, China, that operates within the Chinese pharmaceutical market. It is dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of injectable medications. The firm offers a wide array of products designed to treat conditions related to the cardiovascular, cerebrovascular, immunomodulatory, and nervous systems, among other health areas.
